stem.text: Cyclohexa-1,4-diene is treated with a solution of bromine in tetrachloromethane in the dark.

stem.alt: Skeletal structure of cyclohexa-1,4-diene: a six-membered ring with two C=C double bonds, labelled cyclohexa-1,4-diene.
stem.label: cyclohexa-1,4-diene

A.alt: Cyclohexane ring with Br on four consecutive ring carbons (1,2,3,4-tetrabromocyclohexane).

B.alt: Cyclohexane ring with Br on four ring carbons, the two CH2 carbons opposite each other (1,2,4,5-tetrabromocyclohexane).

C.alt: Six-membered ring with two C=C double bonds and Br on the two opposite sp3 carbons (1,4-dibromocyclohexa-2,5-diene).

D.alt: Cyclohexane ring with two Br on each of two opposite carbons (1,1,4,4-tetrabromocyclohexane).
